title: Comparison of human plasmacytoid dendritic cells and monocyte-derived dendritic cells
description: Transcriptome analysis was conducted to investigate the gene expression profiles of pDCs using bulk RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq). Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from healthy donors (n=3) were stained with lineage markers (CD3, CD14, CD16, CD19, and CD56), and pDCs were identified via flow cytometry (fluorescence-activated cell sorting [FACS]) based on the co-expression of IL-3R (CD123) and BDCA-2 (CD303). mDCs were identified using CD11c and sorted from the same PBMC donor as a control. After sorting, mRNA was extracted from the sorted cells, including mDCs and pDCs. The whole transcriptome profile was analyzed via RNA-seq.

samples.title: mDC1
samples.description: Protocols: Immediately after thawing, PBMCs were stained with antibody cocktails and pDCs were sorted by FACS according to the CD123 (IL-3R) and BDCA-2 (CD303) expressions. As an internal control, mDCs were isolated from the same PBMC donors and simultaneously sorted by FACS according to the CD11c expression. RNA was extracted from the 1 x106 cells by QIAzol Lysis Reagent (QIAGEN). Concentrations of nucleic acids were measured by nanodrop (all experiments) and/or Qubit HS RNA-kit (only for RNA-seq). RNA quantity and quality were measured by Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent technologies). RNA integration values (RIN) >8 were considered to proceed to the further analysis. RNA-seq libraries were generated using Illumina TruSeq Stranded Total RNA kits. The resultant cDNA libraries were quantified via Qubit and assessed for quality via Bioanalyzer.
